A.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: ONE finished static macOS application icon for Dock Enhanced, a native utility for Dock hover window previews and effortless window switching. Create a new design, not a screenshot or marketing mockup. Canvas: exactly square 1024x1024 PNG or larger square. One rounded-square icon tile occupies about 86% of canvas, with balanced transparent margin; genuinely transparent exterior and corners using alpha, opaque tile interior. Quiet solid tile background, no visible gradient bands, spotlight, texture or vignette. Center one confident simple symbol, strong small-size recognition, ample breathing room. Dimensional shallow bas-relief, visible modest thickness, softly rounded bevels and very short contact shadows. Localized softly frosted translucent glass on the main existing symbol surface with gentle transmission and subtle geometry-following highlights; restrained unified material. Single soft upper-left light. Clean unframed tile perimeter with fill to edge. No extra outline, decorative bezel, concentric border, glow, scene reflections, checkerboard, device frame, Dock screenshot, interface contents, titlebar buttons, captions, watermarks, comparison panels or contact sheet. Concept A, "Lifted window": ONE broad pale ice-blue frosted rounded rectangular slab, nearly face-on, lifting directly above ONE short thick cobalt rounded horizontal underline. The slab is an abstract window, no border, no titlebar, no controls, no inset panels. The underline is the minimal Dock metaphor and the only supporting shape. Front-facing composition, slight shallow extrusion only, no dramatic perspective. Background solid rich ocean blue (#1468B8). Window centered slightly above midline, underline centered below with a clear modest gap. Unified blue family with near-white frosted symbol. Keep the window broad, thick, substantial and recognizable at 16 px.

inspection.format: 三张均为正方形 1254×1254 RGBA PNG，含真实透明像素。

inspection.small_sizes: 已观察浅深背景 128/32/16px。A 保留窗口+横条轮廓；B 在32px能看出交叠，16px层次偏弱；C 的D在16px最清晰。
inspection.edge: 已通过内置工具清理一次。正常浅深背景合成预览轮廓干净，原图外缘仍有 alpha=1~4 的极淡残留，未称最终成品；选定后继续处理。
